query: Find countries such that, for every car maker in that country, there exists at least one model whose horsepower is greater than every model made by Japan.
response:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT c.CountryName
FROM countries c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM car_makers cm
    WHERE cm.Country = c.CountryId
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT *
        FROM model_list ml
        JOIN car_names cn ON ml.Model = cn.Model
        JOIN cars_data cd ON cn.MakeId = cd.Id
        WHERE ml.Maker = cm.Id
        AND cd.Horsepower > ALL (
            SELECT cd2.Horsepower
            FROM car_names cn2
            JOIN cars_data cd2 ON cn2.MakeId = cd2.Id
            JOIN model_list ml2 ON cn2.Model = ml2.Model
            JOIN car_makers cm2 ON ml2.Maker = cm2.Id
            JOIN countries c2 ON cm2.Country = c2.CountryId
            WHERE c2.CountryName = 'Japan'
        )
    )
)
```

GROUP BY T1.`Id`, T1.`Maker` 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.`Make`) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T2.`ModelId`) >= 2
```

FROM countries c 
JOIN car_makers cm ON c.`CountryId` = cm.`Country` 
JOIN model_list ml ON cm.`Id` = ml.`Maker` 
JOIN car_names cn ON ml.`Model` = cn.`Model` 
WHERE c.`CountryId` IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.`CountryId` 
    FROM countries c 
    JOIN car_makers cm ON c.`CountryId` = cm.`Country` 
    GROUP BY c.`CountryId` 
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.`Id`) > 3
) OR cn.`Make` = 'fiat'
```
